response.rationale: The item is apparel, not final sale, and delivered 48 days ago. Since days_since_delivery (48) > 30 and final_sale is False, RET-008 applies and the return is outside the standard 30-day window. No higher-priority rule applies: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020, defective is null), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). The customer's change of mind does not override the expired window.
